question: Which materials are enumerated as suitable for ritual vessels?
premises: Vessels may be made of clay.
Vessels may be made of bell-metal or copper.
inference: Ritual vessels may be fashioned from clay, tortoise-derived material, bell-metal, or copper.
uncertainties: The exact nature of kūrmajaṃ as a vessel material is context-dependent.
plain_english: O goddess, vessels may be made of clay, born of a tortoise, made of bell-metal, or made of copper.
